segments.name: Air Transport
segments.description: Runs a single route network for air transport, carrying passengers and cargo within Latin America and to international destinations.
segments.evidence: As of December 31, 2025, the Company considers that it has a single operating segment, Air Transport.

revenueModel.text: Passengers and shippers pay for airline tickets and cargo transportation on the company's route network.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company allocates revenues by geographic area based on the point of sale of the passenger ticket or cargo.
